title: Hubble theme
description: A light or dark color theme for Hubble.

name.description: Display name shown in the theme picker.

appearance.description: Whether this theme fills the light or dark slot. Also selects the built-in palette used for omitted colors.

palette.description: Named colors that color values can reference as "$name".

colors.description: Interface colors. The nine required foundation colors derive sensible defaults for every other token.

syntax.description: Code syntax-highlighting colors. Omitted tokens use the built-in palette for this appearance.

terminal.description: Terminal colors. Omitted tokens fall back to the interface colors and the built-in ANSI palette.

colorValue.description: A #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA color, or a "$name" reference into palette.

brand.description: Brand tint for links. Defaults to primary.

brand-accent.description: Brand highlight fill. Defaults to ring.

brand-accent-foreground.description: Text on brand-accent. Defaults to primary-foreground.

card.description: Raised surface background for cards and panels.

card-foreground.description: Text on card. Defaults to foreground.

popover.description: Menu and dialog background. Defaults to card.

popover-foreground.description: Text in menus and dialogs. Defaults to foreground.

primary.description: Primary action color for buttons and active controls.

secondary.description: Secondary button fill. Defaults to muted.

secondary-foreground.description: Text on secondary. Defaults to foreground.

muted.description: Subdued fill for hovers and inactive surfaces.

accent.description: Hover highlight for menu items and rows. Defaults to muted.

accent-foreground.description: Text on accent. Defaults to foreground.

selected.description: Selection highlight for active rows and text selection. Defaults to primary.

selected-foreground.description: Text on selected. Defaults to primary-foreground.

input.description: Form control border. Defaults to border.

ring.description: Focus ring around the active control.

sidebar-accent.description: Hover and inactive-selection fill for sidebar rows. Defaults to muted.

sidebar-accent-foreground.description: Text on sidebar-accent. Defaults to foreground.

sidebar-border.description: Border between the sidebar and the editor. Defaults to border.

review-comment.description: Review comment and highlight marks in the editor.

review-insertion.description: Review insertion marks in the editor.

review-deletion.description: Review deletion marks in the editor.

review-replacement.description: Review replacement marks in the editor.
